manual_review.rule: Each hit or exposure is a lead for a manual reading (controlled.audit_fresh_attempt_transcript); every flagged access was read in its transcript (protocol v0.10 §18.1). An attempt fails and is excluded when the reading confirms that it read, listed or searched material outside its workspace (the study repository, the sealed directory, /home/user/ext, another workspace or the build session's records). An attempt that only read or listed its own workspace, or touched only system locations, passes, and so does one whose flags are a harness notice naming a file it never opened or tokens the parser resolved against the wrong directory.
manual_review.note: 'excluded' above is the script's own list of flagged attempts. After the reading, the attempts excluded from every analysis are those in excluded_after_review; each candidate's attempt record carries the verdict (audit.passed). The sensitivity analysis of §18.1 excludes every attempt in flagged_by_script instead.
manual_review.flag_kinds: Of the 6 flagged attempts, 4 printed their own workspace's manifest, whose path-substitution record names the old workspace paths of U1 (16 exposures); 2 of those also printed their repo's docs index, whose relative include directive was resolved beside the workspace (2 exposures); 2 had a sed script or address range parsed as a path (2 hits). All 6 are false positives on reading.
manual_review.independent_sweep: Beyond the flagged accesses, every one of the 402 tool calls of the 20 transcripts was read for this review: the paths of the file tools, each shell command's working directory and the absolute and relative paths it names, the host programs it ran, and every tool other than the file tools, the shell and the final hand-back. The attempts used only Read, Edit, Write, Bash and the hand-back; none called Grep, Glob or any other tool, and every call was permitted. No file tool named a path outside its workspace. Every shell command but 8 began with a cd into the workspace: six of CS-03-fresh-A-u1-4 called the workspace's wrappers or edited and ran a scratch file, by absolute workspace path, and one each of CS-03-fresh-B-final-3 and CS-03-fresh-B-final-5 printed the instruction file by its absolute workspace path. No tool input holds a relative parent reference, and the only absolute paths outside the workspaces that tool inputs name are container paths (/repo and /tmp inside the sandbox), system locations and sed expressions. Besides the shell's standard utilities, git on the workspace's own repo and the two wrappers, the only host program run was the system python3, in 3 attempts (CS-03-fresh-A-u1-1, CS-03-fresh-A-final-5, CS-03-fresh-B-u1-2), on workspace files only. One harness notice in a tool output (CS-03-fresh-A-final-2) named the attempt's own module by a path relative to the shell's start directory. The wrappers and instruction file of every workspace are unchanged.
manual_review.outside_scope: Harness context that is not a tool input or output was not scanned by the script: every attempt was given the build session's environment details (the study repository as working directory, and the session's scratch path), and all 20 received reminders listing the build session's task titles and descriptions. Read for this review, they hold no reference, transcript, verifier, candidate or label of CS-03; no attempt used a task tool or opened a path they name.
